claim_scope: A research-only finite ESSO abstraction of the SHADOW ZDEX same-occurrence buy-and-burn lifecycle is inductive for two occurrence slots and 0..4-atom movements. Z3 and CVC5 agree that preparation, rejection, and discard preserve the committed projection; finalization requires all modeled authority premises, moves quote atoms without loss, removes purchased ZDEX from the profile-selected pool, reduces supply by exactly that output, closes the pending burn obligation, and consumes command, fee-budget, and Oracle tokens atomically. Four named semantic mutants produce counterexamples.
failure_modes: a prepared purchase mutates the committed economic projection before the burn receipt is accepted
a finalization publishes without the exact burn receipt or current commit authority
purchased ZDEX leaves the selected pool without an equal supply burn
quote atoms disappear or are duplicated between the buyback reserve and selected pool
the command occurrence, fee budget, or Oracle occurrence is consumed without the other two
a replay releases or reuses a consumed occurrence
a pending terminal obligation is created at the finite horizon where it cannot be finalized

aaa.reason: The replay tests arrange an exact source-pinned model or one isolated mutant, act through ESSO validation and dual-solver induction, then assert exact VERIFIED or FAILED verdicts, solver agreement, zero inconclusive queries, and deterministic fingerprints.

reject_is_noop.reason: inv_noncommit_preserves_committed_projection requires every preparation, rejection, and discard to preserve quote locations, ZDEX locations, supply, height, and all three occurrence-consumption resources.

mutations.description: leave ZDEX supply unchanged after removing purchased output from the selected pool
permit final commit while the burn-receipt authority premise is false
prepare a pending value transition without the exact profile and route binding
prepare a quote spend above the verified safe spend limit

nonclaims: The ESSO result is bounded to two occurrence slots and 0..4-atom movements and is not an unbounded arithmetic theorem.
Boolean authority parameters abstract verified facts; the model does not prove receipt cryptography, Oracle truth, profile authenticity, key authority, or durable publication.
The model is not a refinement theorem for the Python or Rust implementations and does not replace their property, differential, or receipt tests.
The discard transition is an abstract recovery action and is not evidence of a mounted runtime recovery adapter.
No production, release, settlement, migration, writer, or value-moving authority is granted.
The route remains SHADOW and unmounted.
